paragraphs.text: The Sheoltun Occupation was the overseas conquest of eastern Terisian Isles by the Sheoltun Empire.

Having spread their influence across the Domains , including the whole of Aerona and the Spice Isles , the powerful Sheoltun Empire wished to continue to spread their influence in a wider circle. They looked west to the Terisian Isles , where they saw the strategic advantage of controlling the city of Epityr , and sent emissaries demanding that the town surrender to their expansionist nation. The people of Epityr agreed to the Sheoltuns' demands under duress and were forced to model their culture after the Sheoltun way of life. They viewed the Sheoltun rule as tyrannical and demanding, and over the next four decades, seeds of rebellion were sown among the population of Terisiare. In the same period, Sheoltun's rule on this continent would continue to expand to cover the eastern part of the Terisian Isles.
